data.reasoning: This is a standard binary package (-bin) that downloads prebuilt binaries from the official oxc-project/oxc GitHub repository with proper SHA256 checksums. The PKGBUILD contains only standard variable assignments and a package() function that installs binaries and documentation to conventional locations. No injection patterns, unexpected network endpoints, or code execution outside normal packaging operations were found. The 'disagreement' was caused by a tool error (API failure on .SRCINFO in the qwen model), not a security concern.
data.disagreement_analysis: The qwen model returned 'inconclusive' due to an HTTP 400 API error when reviewing .SRCINFO, not due to any security finding. The deepseek model successfully reviewed all 4 files including .SRCINFO and found them safe. The openrouter/free report is advisory-only and does not count as a vote. There is no genuine security disagreement.
coverage_issues: qwen model failed to review .SRCINFO due to API error (HTTP 400 BadRequestError), resulting in an inconclusive verdict
learnings: Tool errors (API failures, timeouts) should be distinguished from security inconclusive verdicts. When a model fails to review a file due to infrastructure issues, the system should either retry or recognize that another model successfully reviewed the same file.

When one model's inconclusive result is caused by a tool error on a specific file, and another model successfully reviewed that same file without issues, the system should not escalate to a full re-audit.
For binary packages (-bin), the audit should verify that source URLs point to legitimate upstream release assets and that checksums are present for all downloaded files.
